name: Health data privacy in insurer AI
blurb: What an insurer's model may learn from, and the HIPAA rules that follow the data into the vendor's system.

points.desc: A model that touches protected health information sits inside HIPAA: minimum necessary access, a business associate agreement with the vendor, audit logs and breach notification. This site's HIPAA and AI page covers each duty.
points.name: HIPAA reaches the vendor

points.desc: Since May 1, 2025, 45 CFR 92.210 requires covered health programs, including insurers, to identify decision support tools that use race, color, national origin, sex, age or disability as inputs and to mitigate the risk of discrimination.
points.name: Section 1557 reaches the tool
